headline: ABITIBI METALS B26: Discovery Silver-Backed Quebec Deposit Hits 46.7m at 1.48% CuEq — Best High-Grade Intercept at Depth
snippet: Abitibi Metals (CSE: AMQ) reported hole 378W1 cutting 46.7 metres of 1.48% CuEq from 946m depth—including 14m at 4.04% CuEq (3.63% Cu, 0.37 g/t Au)—at its high-grade B26 polymetallic deposit in western Québec. Discovery Silver-backed Phase 4 program has now drilled 40,000+ metres and continues to demonstrate grade and width at depth.

headline: WHITE GOLD CORP Launches Largest-Ever 20,000m Yukon Diamond Drill Program, Backed by Agnico Eagle
snippet: White Gold Corp (TSX.V: WGO) mobilized three diamond drill rigs for a 20,000-metre program—the largest in company history—targeting the Golden Saddle, Arc, Ryan's Surprise, and VG deposits in Yukon's White Gold District. The fully funded campaign is backed by Agnico Eagle and will advance a maiden Preliminary Economic Assessment expected in the near term.

headline: AZTEC MINERALS Expands Tombstone Gold-Silver Drill to 22,000m — Arizona JV Program Now One of TSXV's Largest
snippet: Aztec Minerals Corp approved a 3,500-metre extension to its North Contention RC drill program at the Tombstone joint venture in Arizona, bringing the 2025–26 combined drill campaign to approximately 22,000 metres with a C$1.4 million budget addition. Results from the expanded Northern Contention area are expected in Q4 2026.

headline: GROUP ELEVEN Drills 11.8m of 13.4% Zn+Pb at Ballywire; 720m Step-Out Confirms New Deeper Cu-Ag System
snippet: Glencore-backed Group Eleven Resources (TSX.V: ZNG) released assays from three new holes at its Ballywire VMS discovery in Ireland. The headline hole returned 11.8m of 13.4% Zn+Pb and 45 g/t Ag from an 80m step-out, while a separate 720m step-out hole confirmed a new deeper copper-silver zone—dramatically expanding the potential scale of the PG West system.

headline: GIUSTRA: "The Price of Copper Has to Go Up" — Supply Crunch Demands Higher Prices to Fund the Mines the World Needs
snippet: Mining financier Frank Giustra told The Northern Miner that copper prices must rise substantially to incentivize the mine-building required to meet AI data-centre, grid, and electrification demand. He warns that majors gun-shy from the last cycle are compounding a supply gap that rising prices alone can fix—but only if the industry acts now.

headline: MAGNA MINING Q1 2026: Canada's Newest Nickel-Copper-PGM Producer Posts Positive Cash Margin at McCreedy West
snippet: Magna Mining (TSX-V: NICU) reported a positive $6M cash margin at its McCreedy West mine in Sudbury, Ontario, with Q1 revenue of $25.4M, production of 4.1 million CuEq payable pounds, and AISC of US$4.21/CuEq lb. The company also received conditional TSX listing approval, signalling its transition from developer to established producer.
